summary: Tested Romanian parenting guide app (Expo + FastAPI + MongoDB + Claude). All 17 backend pytest tests PASS (auth register/login/me, categories list/single/404, search, bookmarks CRUD + auth gating, journal CRUD, article AI generation + cache + auth gating). Frontend: login screen renders correctly in Romanian with leaf logo, login succeeds with test@test.com/test123 (POST /api/auth/login -> 200), navigates to home dashboard showing all 5 colored category cards + bottom tab bar (Acasă, Căutare, Jurnal, Profil), tapping category navigates to /category/cat-1 showing 3 subtopics, tapping subtopic loads /article/sub-1-1 with AI-generated content (Introducere paragraphs + Puncte Cheie section rendered). All sub-1-* articles already cached in Mongo so loads are instant.

minor.issue: Returns 404 only because subtopic not found; cache lookup happens BEFORE auth check is enforced (auth is via Depends so it runs first). Acceptable.

ui_bugs.issue: Console warning: '"brain" is not a valid icon name for family "ionicons"'. The first category (cat-1) shows a generic '?' placeholder instead of an icon. Other icons (heart, shield-checkmark, flash, thunderstorm) render correctly. Replace 'brain' with a valid Ionicons name (e.g. 'bulb', 'sparkles', 'school', 'analytics' or 'extension-puzzle').

issues: Interactive elements lack testID attributes (email-input, password-input, login-button missing). Tests had to fall back to text/index selectors.
No testID on category cards, subtopic rows, tab buttons, bookmark icon. Add testID to all TouchableOpacity/Pressable to make automated testing reliable.

react_native_issues.issue: Deprecation warnings (non-blocking): 'shadow*' style props deprecated, use boxShadow; props.pointerEvents deprecated, use style.pointerEvents; Image style.resizeMode deprecated, use props.resizeMode.

action_items: Replace invalid Ionicons name 'brain' for cat-1 in /app/backend/server.py with a valid Ionicons name (e.g. 'bulb', 'sparkles', 'extension-puzzle') so the icon renders instead of a '?' placeholder.

Add testID props to all interactive elements: email-input, password-input, login-button, register-button, category-card-{id}, subtopic-{id}, bookmark-toggle, tab-acasa/cautare/jurnal/profil, journal-add, journal-save, journal-delete, logout-button. This dramatically improves test reliability.
Optional cleanup: migrate shadow* style props to boxShadow, pointerEvents to style.pointerEvents, and Image resizeMode to props (non-blocking warnings).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is a single 450-line file containing models, auth, categories data, AI prompt, and all routes. Acceptable for MVP but consider splitting (routers/auth.py, routers/articles.py, data/categories.py) if it grows.
AI article cache key is subtopic_id only (no versioning). If prompt or category title changes, stale cached articles will be served. Consider including a prompt-version field.
/api/article/{id} returns 404 with same status as 'subtopic not found' regardless of auth; auth dependency runs first which is correct.
Search is case-insensitive and substring-based - works correctly for 'meltdown' matching cat-5 title.

success_rate.frontend: ~85% (login, home, category, article verified end-to-end; journal/search/profile UI flows verified at API level only due to spinner timing in second playwright run)

seed_data_creation: No persistent seed data created; per-test bookmarks and journal entries were created and cleaned up. AI articles cached in db.articles for sub-1-1 and sub-2-1 (from prior runs) - these are intentional cache entries.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Frontend uses EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (not EXPO_BACKEND_URL). Test user test@test.com/test123 exists. AI article gen takes 30-60s on first call; sub-1-1 and sub-2-1 are already cached. Login spinner can take 2-3s after click - wait at least 4s before clicking tabs. No testIDs in UI yet, use get_by_text or input index selectors.
rca_of_issue: Icon '?' on cat-1: backend returns icon: 'brain' which is not a valid @expo/vector-icons Ionicons glyph (Ionicons uses names like 'bulb', 'heart', 'shield-checkmark'). React Native logs warning and renders fallback '?'. Fix: change CATEGORIES[0]['icon'] in /app/backend/server.py from 'brain' to a valid Ionicons name.
